filing: the quarterly report identified by {accession}, form {form}, for the period ended {period_end}, read at the cutoff {cutoff}
purpose: bear, base and bull drivers for a ten-year discounted cash flow; every driver is a decimal, and every reason rests on a verbatim quote or on calculator fields
author: single-agent control (one agent, no reader or analyst layers)

shared.terminal_growth_ceiling: terminal growth in every scenario is held at or below the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value}
shared.reinvestment_definition: net capital expenditure plus the change in trade working capital plus acquisitions, as a share of after-tax operating income; depreciation and amortization are untagged for the period ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}), so the rates below are set on the gross capital expenditure {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value}, the rise in trade working capital from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier.value} to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now.value}, and acquisitions of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value}, with judgment for the untagged depreciation offset

bear.narrative: AI-infrastructure demand pauses after the inventory and purchase commitments have been placed; services and subscription keep shrinking; memory costs stay high; the restructuring charge lands and inventory provisions rise; growth reverts to the long-run record.

revenue_growth_year_one.reason: The three-year compound revenue growth is only {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound} and the fiscal year two years back fell {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.revenue_growth}; remaining performance obligations are flat, deferred revenue is down, and the recurring lines are shrinking, so a pause in hardware orders leaves little underneath. The bear takes a rate near the long-run compound pace rather than a decline, because half of the remaining obligations still convert within twelve months.

terminal_growth.reason: Below the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value} and below the three-year compound revenue growth {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound}, reflecting a mature hardware franchise whose software transition has stalled.
terminal_growth.quote: Revenue in our Security product category was flat, primarily driven by declines in our prior generation products and Splunk offerings. We continued to see a change in how our customers consumed Splunk offerings, shifting from fewer on-premise deals to more cloud subscriptions. These declines were offset by growth in new and refreshed products.

operating_margin_year_one.reason: Set near the prior fiscal year's restructuring-depressed margin {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin}: the new plan's charges of up to a billion dollars land over the next year, product gross margin is already falling on mix and memory, and the shrinking inventory reserve leaves room for a write-down if demand pauses.
operating_margin_year_one.quote: We expect to recognize approximately $450 million in pre-tax charges in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026. The total pre-tax charges are estimated to be up to $1 billion, with the plan expected to be substantially completed by the end of fiscal 2027.

operating_margin_year_ten.reason: A hardware-weighted mix with recurring restructuring keeps the long-run margin near the prior fiscal year's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin} and below the three-year average {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average}; the amortization tailwind that helped this year fades by schedule.
operating_margin_year_ten.quote: We expect to reinvest substantially all of the cost savings from this restructuring plan in our key growth opportunities. As a result, the overall cost savings from this restructuring plan are not expected to be material.

reinvestment_rate_year_one.reason: The inventory and commitment build continues into a demand pause: trade working capital already rose from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier.value} to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now.value}, capital expenditure rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value}, and the company says inventory may increase further, so a high share of after-tax operating income is absorbed before any is free.
reinvestment_rate_year_one.quote: We expect our inventory balances may increase in future quarters as we work to fulfill this demand.

reinvestment_rate_year_ten.reason: Terminal reinvestment is terminal growth divided by the return on capital that persists; in the bear the return fades from today's {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital.value} toward the cost of capital {cost_of_capital.wacc.value}, so even a low terminal growth needs a sizable share of after-tax operating income reinvested.
reinvestment_rate_year_ten.quote: In recent periods, we have increased our levels of inventory and purchase commitments with contract manufacturers and suppliers primarily related to Cisco Silicon One.

base.narrative: The hardware upcycle continues at a slower pace, services and subscription stabilize, the restructuring charge is absorbed, gross margin stays under mix pressure but operating leverage holds, and working-capital intensity eases after the current build.

revenue_growth_year_one.reason: Trailing revenue growth is {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value} and the latest quarter grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year.value} year over year, but the three-year compound rate is {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound}, remaining performance obligations are flat and services are not growing, so the base takes a rate between the trailing pace and the long-run pace.
revenue_growth_year_one.quote: Total remaining performance obligations as of April 25, 2026 were flat compared to the end of fiscal 2025. Remaining performance obligations for product increased by 2% compared to the end of fiscal 2025, of which long-term product RPO was $11.7 billion, up 2%. Remaining performance obligations for services decreased 3%.

terminal_growth.reason: Below the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value} and close to the three-year compound revenue growth {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound}, which is what a mature networking franchise has actually delivered through a full cycle.
terminal_growth.quote: Total revenue increased by 10%. Product revenue increased by 13% and services revenue was flat. Our total revenue reflected growth across each of our geographic segments.

operating_margin_year_one.reason: Held at the trailing operating margin {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value}: the nine-month margin runs above it and the third quarter higher still, but the fourth-quarter restructuring charge and a product gross margin that fell on mix and memory offset that run-rate over the next year.
operating_margin_year_one.quote: Operating income increased by 24%, and operating income as a percentage of revenue increased by 2.4 percentage points. These changes primarily resulted from revenue growth, partially offset by lower gross margin in the third quarter of fiscal 2026.

operating_margin_year_ten.reason: Between the three-year average {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average} and the margin of the fiscal year three years back {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin}, assuming operating leverage on a stable gross margin and no further step-up in restructuring, but not a return to the pre-acquisition margins of five and six years back.
operating_margin_year_ten.quote: As a percentage of revenue, research and development, sales and marketing, and general and administrative expenses, collectively, decreased by 2.6 percentage points.

reinvestment_rate_year_one.reason: Trade working capital rose from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier.value} to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now.value}, capital expenditure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure.value} a year earlier, and acquisitions were only {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value}; against after-tax operating income built from {ebit.value} and {tax_rate.value}, and with an untagged depreciation offset that would lower the net figure, a fifth of after-tax operating income is the base for a year in which the inventory build continues but at a slower pace.
reinvestment_rate_year_one.quote: The increases during the first nine months of fiscal 2026 were primarily due to arrangements to secure supply and pricing for certain product components, including memory, and commitments with contract manufacturers to meet customer demand and help manage lead times.

reinvestment_rate_year_ten.reason: Terminal reinvestment equals terminal growth divided by the return on invested capital that persists; with the return fading from today's {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital.value} toward a level still above the cost of capital {cost_of_capital.wacc.value}, a little over a fifth of after-tax operating income sustains the base terminal growth.
reinvestment_rate_year_ten.quote: Our inventory purchase commitments are for short-term product manufacturing requirements as well as for commitments to suppliers to secure manufacturing capacity.

bull.narrative: AI-infrastructure and campus refresh demand persists at the current pace, Silicon One and optics take share, Security and Splunk return to growth on the cloud transition, gross margin stabilizes as memory costs ease, and the restructuring redirects spend toward the growth lines without a margin cost.

revenue_growth_year_one.reason: The latest quarter grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year.value} year over year with Networking up by a quarter and growth in every geography; the bull assumes that pace carries through a full year with services stable, above the trailing {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value}.
revenue_growth_year_one.quote: Revenue from the Networking product category increased by 25%, or $1.7 billion primarily driven by our AI Infrastructure and Campus Networking solutions. The increase was primarily driven by growth across the portfolio led by double digit revenue growth in Campus Switching, Data Center Switching, Wireless and Service Provider Routing.

terminal_growth.reason: Still below the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value}; a franchise that keeps its position in AI networking and revives its software lines can grow a little faster than the three-year compound {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound} in perpetuity, but not faster than the economy's nominal rate.
terminal_growth.quote: In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, we announced a restructuring plan to allow us to invest in key growth opportunities including silicon, optics, security and AI.

operating_margin_year_one.reason: The third-quarter operating margin reached a quarter of revenue and the nine-month margin is above the trailing {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value}; the bull assumes opex leverage continues and the restructuring charge is offset by revenue growth within the year.
operating_margin_year_one.quote: Operating income increased by 28%, and operating income as a percentage of revenue increased by 3.4 percentage points. These changes primarily resulted from revenue growth, lower restructuring and other charges and lower amortization of purchased intangible assets in the first nine months of fiscal 2026.

operating_margin_year_ten.reason: A return toward the margins of the fiscal years five and six years back, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_margin} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_margin}, as purchased-intangible amortization runs off by schedule, acquisition compensation fades, and software lines grow again.
operating_margin_year_ten.quote: For each of the third quarter and first nine months of fiscal 2026, the decrease in amortization of purchased intangible assets was primarily due to certain purchased intangible assets that became fully amortized and impairment charges of $19 million recognized in the first nine months of fiscal 2025.

reinvestment_rate_year_one.reason: The inventory placed this year sells through, so trade working capital stops rising from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now.value}; capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value} and small acquisitions {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value} are the remaining reinvestment against after-tax operating income built from {ebit.value} and {tax_rate.value}.
reinvestment_rate_year_one.quote: The combined increase of 93% in our inventory and inventory purchase commitments as compared with the end of fiscal 2025 was primarily related to commitments with contract manufacturers and suppliers related to manufacturing Cisco Silicon One and other products to meet the demand from hyperscalers and other customers.

reinvestment_rate_year_ten.reason: With the return on invested capital holding near today's {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital.value}, the bull terminal growth needs less than a fifth of after-tax operating income reinvested; the rate is kept above the pure ratio to allow for continued silicon and optics investment.
reinvestment_rate_year_ten.quote: R&D expenses increased primarily due to higher share-based compensation expense, higher discretionary spending and higher headcount-related expenses reflecting our investments in AI, partially offset by lower acquisition-related costs and lower contracted services spending.

cross_scenario_notes: Operating margin in every scenario is a GAAP margin including share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} and recurring restructuring; no non-GAAP add-backs are assumed.
Other income from Level three investment gains and any tariff refund are excluded from operating margin in every scenario; they are non-operating.

The starting invested capital {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital.invested_capital.value} nets out cash and investments and includes operating leases, consistent with the calculator; inventory purchase commitments are not capitalized because they are untagged and will become inventory as they are honored.

Because depreciation and amortization are untagged for the period, reinvestment rates are judgments anchored on gross capital expenditure and the working-capital change rather than computed net figures; a valuation run should recompute them once the annual report tags the year.
Terminal growth never exceeds the risk-free rate {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value}; the bull sits below it by design.
limits: This is a single-agent control: the drivers were set by the same agent that wrote the accounting and financial analyses, with no separate valuation analyst to challenge them.
No earnings-release current report body or management guidance is on record before the cutoff, so revenue and margin drivers rest on the quarterly report alone.

Depreciation and amortization are missing from the calculator for the current year to date, so free cash flow to the firm and net reinvestment could not be computed; the reinvestment rates are set with judgment on gross figures.
The customer-concentration facts are empty in the calculator, so the dependence on service-provider and cloud customers is inferred from prose.
The trend table lacks fiscal fourth quarters and most MD&A paragraphs are marked unchanged and not reproduced, which limits the view of seasonality and of management's longer discussion.
There are no prior predictions for this company against which to calibrate the scenarios.
